ownership.IbByteSpanV1: caller; callback out-spans point to registration-owned memory kept valid until that callback's next invocation or destroy
ownership.IbBuilderHandleV2: library; consumed by ib_harness_builder_build_v2 on both success and failure, otherwise release with ib_harness_builder_destroy_v2
ownership.IbCancellationHandle: library; release with ib_harness_cancel_destroy_v1 after all runs stop
ownership.registration user_data: C host; released through the registration's destroy callback, fired exactly once

lifecycle.register: register_model/tool/memory/permission in any order; a REJECTED registration consumes the builder (all its registrations are released, destroy callbacks fire, later registrations return IB_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT, and destroy still runs exactly once); argument validation happens BEFORE the builder is taken, so a bad size tag or null span leaves the builder usable
lifecycle.build: ib_harness_builder_build_v2 consumes the builder and returns a v1-compatible harness handle
lifecycle.run: ib_harness_run_v2 with caller-selected provider/model/capability bitmask; the Model capability bit (0) is required; optional out_audit receives the hash-chained session ledger as canonical JSONL

marshalling: all JSON is the core's bounded UTF-8 JSON (Value); enum fields are the C encodings documented in include/inbharat_harness.h
compatibility: ABI v1 symbols are unchanged and remain exported alongside v2
